signature: An incidence matrix of a hypergraph whose hyperedges are bounded-multiplicity walks in a host graph, with an interlacement constraint, claimed to lie in the regular or network matrix class. The operation is rounding a fractional selection to an integral one so that every row load is preserved as closely as possible. The bounded quantity is an additive supremum-norm per-row imbalance, claimed to be a fixed fraction of a maximum degree parameter, in an asymptotic regime of unbounded coverage multiplicity.
